'''Striar''' was the [[Star/Legends|star]] at the center of the [[Malastare system/Legends|Malastare system]] in the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was orbited by eight [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].
